usageNotes: Retrieves the settings for a single IP or CIDR entry within a named IPSet on a QEMU VM's firewall. Use this to inspect a specific entry (including any attached comment) when you already know the exact CIDR value; if you need to enumerate all entries in the set, list the IPSet instead. Requires VM.Audit on the target VM; the hosting node must be online.

examples.summary: Read a specific CIDR entry from a VM's firewall IPSet

tips: The 'cidr' path param accepts bare IPs (e.g. 192.168.1.50), CIDR ranges, or IPSet aliases — match exactly what was used when the entry was created.
The IPSet name must match the pattern [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\-\_]+ (2–64 chars); names starting with a digit are invalid.
A 'nomatch' flag on the entry (negation prefix '!') is returned in the response object — check for it when building firewall logic.
